Southeast Michigan Nonprofits

Source: IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File, Michigan file, saved when this page was built. 501(c)(3) organizations with ZIP codes 480 to 483, without hospitals and medical care organizations. Revenue comes from each organization's latest filing on record, so years differ, and many small organizations report zero. "Since" is the year of the IRS ruling. Map positions are ZIP code centers from the Census Bureau.
